title: Eval-harness adapter for scoring shadow outputs (rubric version pinning)
creator: Jonas Weber
project: Shadow traffic tool for eval metrics
description:
Goal
Build an adapter layer so the shadow scoring workers (ENG-5405) can reuse eval-harness templates/rubrics against captured shadow outputs with minimal glue code. Must support rubric version pinning so results are comparable within an experiment/run and auditable later.

Context
Shadow traffic produces (control_output, shadow_output) pairs asynchronously. We want to score these outputs using the same eval-harness infrastructure used for prompt-set evals, but without requiring a full “prompt set” object or customer-provided code execution.

Scope
- Define a canonical “ShadowScoringJob” mapping from shadow artifacts -> eval-harness run input.
- Implement adapter that:
  1) resolves the minimal required inputs (prompt/context, control output, shadow output, metadata)
  2) selects templates/rubrics (by metric bundle id + pinned rubric_version)
  3) invokes eval-harness runner with deterministic settings
  4) stores per-example scores + aggregates references (handled by scoring pipeline; adapter returns normalized output)
- Rubric version pinning and auditability:
  - experiment config pins rubric_bundle_id + rubric_version
  - scoring jobs include rubric_version in all outputs/events
  - prevent “silent upgrades” of rubric definitions for in-flight experiments
- Privacy/retention alignment:
  - adapter must be able to operate when prompt text is redacted/truncated (use redacted_text + structured fields allowlist)
  - do not require raw prompt storage beyond retention window; job payload should reference artifacts by opaque ids where possible

Non-goals (this ticket)
- Building new rubrics/metrics (tracked under PM-1843 and Applied ML work)
- Console UX and experiment CRUD
- Statistical aggregation / confidence intervals (handled in analytics layer)

Proposed design
Inputs
- Shadow pair event / artifact ref produced by telemetry + ingestion (ENG-5404):
  - request_fingerprint (stable)
  - request_type (chat/completions/embeddings) — v1: chat/completions only
  - prompt_ref (opaque id) OR redacted prompt payload
  - control: model_id, model_version, output_ref
  - shadow: model_id, model_version, output_ref
  - route_id, experiment_id, variant_id
  - timestamps + outcome (timeouts/errors)

Adapter interface
- Library: eval_harness_shadow_adapter
- Entry point (worker-side): build_eval_harness_run(job)
  - resolves refs (prompt/output) via scoring pipeline artifact fetcher
  - normalizes into eval-harness Example objects
  - attaches required metadata tags with strict cardinality controls (no user ids, no raw route names; prefer hashed/bucketed fields)

Rubric selection + pinning
- Inputs to adapter include:
  - rubric_bundle_id (e.g., default-quality-v1)
  - rubric_version (semver-ish string, e.g., 1.0.3)
  - template_ids subset (optional; defaults to bundle)
- Adapter enforces:
  - rubric_version is required for shadow experiments (no “latest”)
  - fails job (soft-fail, counted) if version not found (do NOT fall back to latest)
  - emits rubric_bundle_id + rubric_version in all result rows

Determinism / reproducibility constraints
- Pin eval-harness runner version via container tag (scoring worker already pins)
- Fix random seeds where applicable (sampling in model-graded templates)
- Record the grader model/version used for model-graded rubrics (in results metadata)

Error handling
- Fail-open relative to user path is already guaranteed; for scoring:
  - adapter should return structured error codes for: artifact_not_found, rubric_not_found, invalid_request_type, prompt_redacted_insufficient, grader_timeout
  - scoring worker decides retry policy (retry only for transient fetch/timeouts)

Acceptance criteria
- ShadowScoringJob -> eval-harness run works end-to-end in staging for:
  - format adherence (heuristic) + refusal rate (heuristic) + instruction following (model-graded)
- Results include rubric_bundle_id + rubric_version and are stable across reruns given same inputs
- Adapter does not emit high-cardinality labels (validated by telemetry review checklist)
- Works with redacted prompt payloads (minimum viable: truncated content + role structure for chat)
- Documentation:
  - README for adapter inputs/outputs
  - example job fixture committed for regression tests

Implementation plan
1) Define job schema + fixtures (owned here)
2) Implement adapter library + unit tests
3) Add integration test that runs adapter against a small set of captured shadow fixtures (no prod data)
4) Wire into scoring worker behind feature flag SHADOW_SCORING_USE_EVAL_HARNESS
5) Add rubric registry lookup + pinning enforcement

Links
- PR (eval-harness): https://github.com/eval-harness/pull/812 (Shadow output adapter + rubric runner)
- Shadow scoring pipeline ticket: ENG-5405
- Telemetry events ticket: ENG-5404
- Data retention/redaction implementation: ENG-5411
- Slack thread (rubric pinning): sources/slack/eng-ml/1768015506-rubric-versioning-for-shadow-scoring.json

Open questions
- What is the minimal prompt representation needed for model-graded templates to remain meaningful under redaction?
  - Proposal: retain system + last user turn (truncated) for model-graded templates; otherwise mark as “unscorable_redacted” and exclude from aggregates.
- Do we allow different rubric versions within the same experiment across time?
  - Proposal: no. Changing rubric_version requires creating a new experiment revision (new experiment_id or run_id).
- Private deployments: can air-gapped customers run model-graded rubrics?
  - Proposal: yes only if they configure a local grader model endpoint; otherwise only heuristic templates enabled. Adapter should handle “grader_unavailable” and skip model-graded templates when configured.

Security/compliance notes
- Adapter must not log raw prompts/outputs at INFO. All logs should use artifact ids + request_fingerprint.
- Ensure any cached artifacts in worker are in-memory only (or ephemeral disk with short TTL) and respect retention config.

Test plan
- Unit tests:
  - schema validation
  - rubric_version required and enforced
  - deterministic outputs for fixed fixture
  - redaction path returns correct error/skip reason
- Integration:
  - local run of eval-harness runner with pinned templates
  - simulate transient artifact fetch failure -> retryable error

Rollout
- Stage: enable feature flag for internal dogfood tenant only
- Beta: enable for select Dedicated tenants after SRE confirms scoring lag SLOs

Definition of done
- Adapter merged + versioned
- Scoring worker uses adapter behind flag
- Rubric pinning verified via stored results (bundle+version populated)
- Reviewed by Applied ML (Karthik Iyer or Selene Huang) and Security (Marcus Lin) for data handling
